description: The LLM assistant and the meme search of the WojtusDiscord bot. Volume is low (about 30 conversation turns a month), so panels show counts per interval and totals, not rates. Job wojtusdiscord.
title: WojtusDiscord / Conversation & Memes

options.content: **What do the assistant and the meme search do, how long do they take, what do they cost?** Volume is low: widen the time range for history.

panels.title: Turns
